preconditions.description: The number of gifts n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The list of pleasantness values contains exactly n integers.
Each pleasantness value is between -10^9 and 10^9 inclusive.
There are exactly n-1 edges describing the tree structure.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct valid gift IDs between 1 and n.
The edges form a valid tree rooted at gift 1, where every node is reachable from node 1.

postconditions.description: If there are fewer than 2 gifts, the output is 'Impossible' because two distinct gifts cannot be chosen.
If n >= 2, the output is an integer representing the maximum sum.

postconditions.expression: (n >= 2) and (int(stdout) == max((subtree_sum[u] + subtree_sum[v]) for u in range(1, n+1) for v in range(1, n+1) if u != v and not is_ancestor(u, v) and not is_ancestor(v, u)))
postconditions.description: The output integer equals the maximum sum of pleasantness of two disjoint subtrees rooted at distinct nodes u and v, where neither is an ancestor of the other.
